item.title: 19k-Mile 2010 Mini Cooper S at No Reserve
item.description: This 2010 Mini Cooper S has 19k miles and remained under the care of its original owner until it was acquired by the selling dealer in 2026. Power is provided by a turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-four paired with a six-speed automatic transaxle, and the car is finished in Pepper White over Carbon Black leatherette. item.title: Fuel-Injected 1977 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am
item.description: This 1977 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am was purchased by the seller in 2022, and subsequent work is said to consist of rebuilding the engine and installing a Holley Sniper EFI system. The car is finished in Starlight Black over black vinyl and is powered by a 400ci V8 linked with a three-speed automatic transmission and a Safe-T-Track limited-slip differential. item.title: 2013 Lamborghini Gallardo LP550-2 Coupe
item.description: This 2013 Lamborghini Gallardo LP550-2 coupe was sold new through Luxury Cars Los Gatos in California before being acquired by the current owner in 2016.
